title: Investment in the Contract for Income Annuities Commuted Value Lump Sums: Annuitized Deferred Annuities and IRAs
content:
When a commuted value lump sum is paid on an Ashgrove Income Annuities contract, the investment in the contract is the amount against which the tax-free return of investment is measured. It is fixed as follows:

1. **Contract bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove fixed indexed annuity or an Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity.** The investment in the contract is the cost basis of the annuity annuitized — the cost basis shown on the record of that Fixed Indexed Annuities or Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.
2. **Traditional IRA or SEP IRA not bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove deferred annuity.** The investment in the contract is zero.
3. **Any other contract.** For every other Income Annuities contract — for example one bought with new money or through a 1035 exchange — the investment in the contract is the purchase amount.

The income annuity contract record shows the purchase source, the reference number of any Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity or fixed indexed annuity annuitized into it, and the tax qualification.

| Purchase source on the income contract | Tax qualification | Investment in the contract |
|---|---|---|
| Annuitization of an Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity | Non-qualified | Cost basis on the Deferred Fixed Annuities contract |
| Annuitization of an Ashgrove fixed indexed annuity | Non-qualified | Cost basis on the Fixed Indexed Annuities contract |
| Annuitization of an Ashgrove deferred fixed annuity | Traditional IRA | Cost basis on the Deferred Fixed Annuities contract |
| IRA rollover | Traditional IRA | Zero |
| IRA transfer | SEP IRA | Zero |
| New money | Non-qualified | The purchase amount |
| 1035 exchange | Non-qualified | The purchase amount |

*Hypothetical.* A contract bought by annuitizing an Ashgrove IndexEdge contract whose record shows a cost basis of $95,000.00 has an investment in the contract of $95,000.00, whatever the purchase amount applied to the income contract. A non-qualified contract bought with $120,000.00 of new money has an investment in the contract of $120,000.00, its purchase amount.
